name: PowerShell
description: Installs PowerShell (pwsh) from the self-contained Linux tarball, which bundles its own .NET runtime. Pairs with the ms-vscode.PowerShell extension, whose linting runs PSScriptAnalyzer inside a real pwsh host.

installPSScriptAnalyzer.description: Also install PSScriptAnalyzer system-wide, so Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer works from the shell and in pre-commit, not only inside the editor.
